captions: What if Earth's atmosphere disappeared for 5 seconds?
The sky turns black. Stars at 10 in the morning.
Every tower is still full of air, pushing out.
10 tonnes on every square metre of glass. It gives.
In total silence. Sound needs air to travel.
With no pressure, water boils at body temperature.
At second 5 the air slams back in. One giant boom.
Five seconds without air. The sky comes back. The windows don't.
